name: pm-kit
description: Claude Code skills for project-board management with Fraction hygiene applied at the point of writing: create a single card correctly (INBOX vs BACKLOG, Feature, standard custom fields, duplicate check, source attribution), post correctly-formatted comments, bootstrap a new Asana project to standard, audit and fix an existing Asana board. Also keeps a local project folder per project: plan from raw idea to shippable initiative, write planning docs, turn call transcripts into meeting files, log stray notes, triage the tracker against its roadmap, draft a CEO brief, and draft full card bodies. Ships a first-party Asana MCP server. Use for "add a ticket", "log a bug", "track this", "clean up the board", "asana hygiene", "enrich the backlog", "create an Asana project", "plan <project>", "process this call", "log this", "tracker hygiene", "write the card for X", "vision doc".
